policy.finalPlacement: independent rerun on the same advanced role search stream

sourceRelationship.searchStreamDivergence: only after a registry-declared hazard preview consumes tie-jitter samples

seedDerivation: deriveGameSeed from frozen rune-matchups v1; domains #supply, #search-opener, #search-reply

fieldSemantics.hazardPreviews: machineCastPlan called a placement preview because the chosen cast target declared one or more forbidden placements
fieldSemantics.vetoes: hazard preview chose a forbidden placement and machineCastPlan returned no cast target
fieldSemantics.hazardousSuccessfulCasts: a hazard preview ran, chose a safe placement, and machineCastPlan retained the cast target
fieldSemantics.immediateRedundantPlacements: after a hazardous successful cast, Normal independently chose a placement forbidden for that cast target
fieldSemantics.previewFinalDivergences: hazard preview column differed from Normal final placement column
fieldSemantics.immediateSwing: board-score swing recorded by frozen v1 at cast application; WARD itself has zero immediate board swing

targetedSummary.scope: COLSHIELD only; seat-neutral WARD outcomes pooled across requested replications
targetedSummary.limitation: This targeted substitution cannot recompute the seven-mode weighted wheel or global dominance relations; unchanged cells remain only in the baseline files.
